name: pi-office
description: Read and annotate artifacts (Markdown, HTML, text) inside pi's TUI, and send line-anchored edit requests to the agent

scripts.test: node scripts/align-check.ts && node scripts/yank-check.ts && node scripts/compose-check.ts && node scripts/preview.ts > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts pretty > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts deck > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts present > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts wrap > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts help > /dev/null && node scripts/preview.ts html > /dev/null
